name: Vaultix Sync
author: FrancisCreation
description: Syncs a folder of your Vaultix cloud drive with the ncSender file manager on a kiosk. Sign in with your Vaultix account (two-factor codes and app passwords work), pick a folder, and its G-code files appear under Vaultix in the file manager; files made on the kiosk go back up. On a desktop it shows how to set up the Vaultix app instead.
